description: Tuples \(\bar a\in M^n\) and \(\bar b\in N^n\) satisfy the same first-order formulas if and only if there is a finite partial elementary map with domain exactly the range of \(\bar a\), range exactly the range of \(\bar b\), and values \(a_i\mapsto b_i\) for every coordinate. Repetitions and \(n=0\) are allowed.
